title: Frequently Asked Questions
description: Find answers to the most common questions about AthletiX platform.

what-is-athletix.question: What is AthletiX?
what-is-athletix.answer: AthletiX is a comprehensive fitness platform that connects clients, trainers, and sports clubs. It provides tools for training management, communication, and business growth in the fitness industry.

how-to-start.question: How can I start using AthletiX?
how-to-start.answer: Getting started with AthletiX is easy! Simply create an account, choose your role (client, trainer, or business), and follow the setup wizard to customize your profile and preferences.

pricing.question: What are the pricing plans?
pricing.answer: AthletiX offers flexible pricing plans for different user types. We have free and premium options for clients, trainers, and businesses. Visit our pricing page for detailed information about each plan.

security.question: Is my data secure?
security.answer: Yes, we take data security very seriously. All data is encrypted, and we follow industry best practices for data protection. We regularly update our security measures to ensure your information remains safe.

support.question: How can I get support?
support.answer: We offer multiple support channels including email support, documentation, and a help center. You can also contact our support team directly through the platform.

contact-link.question: Still have questions?
contact-link.answer: Couldn't find what you're looking for? Our support team is here to help! Get in touch with us and we'll get back to you as soon as possible.
